Markdrop turns Markdown documents and files into links. Press :kbd[⌘K] to search.

## Publish a document

Write Markdown at [markdrop.in/new](https://markdrop.in/new) and choose **Publish**. See [custom domains](/workspaces/custom-domain#check-dns).

:::tip[No account needed]
Documents never need an account.
:::

## Publish a document

A second heading with the same text gets a numbered id.

```bash title="Install"
## not a heading inside code
curl -fsSL https://example.com/install.sh | sh
```
